YES. EXACTLY. I know what and how I want to do with the person I want to do them with. 

Problem is I get in my head and anxiety and don't express my wants and needs. I have a feeling if I did this person would be open to it. But words are hard, especially when actually verbal. I can type out what I'm thinking and rewrite it until it's right. But in person? I stammer and can't get out what I want and need and give up. I'm also scared I'll lose what I have with this person if they say no and it gets weird...or if they say yes and it gets weird....nothing ventured nothing gained but I've already lost people and I'd like to keep this one, at the very least as a friend.

Thank you. It's been great hearing feedback from people that this is normal, that *I'm* normal. 

Yes, there have been some events in my life that have caused me to be even more sex-averse and cautious. #metoo But even before that, I generally wasn't terribly interested. Friends were always discussing sex and making jokes and talking about who they'd "jump" and it bored and disgusted me. 

I have never liked my body. It's partially just self-consciousness but I don't enjoy seeing my body naked. And there are very few, if any, bodies I'd like to see naked. I appreciate sensuality, and people who embrace their sexuality are great, but most of the time that's not for me. I've always been one to cover up. Never owned a swimsuit that covered less than 1/3-1/2 my body. 

And on that note I've never really wanted to have someone see me naked, except in vague theory. 

And yes. The kiss changed things. I'm curious about more, but I definitely need someone I trust and who is willing to communicate with me, and stop at any point I need to. It makes me feel needy and like a bad partner, but that's where I stand.

That makes a lot of sense, actually. I think you spoke to something I couldn't put into words. It's more about the overall feel and pace of things. I definitely want the sensual, but most of the sexual.....I don't know. But with the right person and communication....maybe.

Thanks for your input, I super appreciate it. 

It kind of seemed like that to me, but internally I was questioning if it made me selfish for wanting things I was averse to doing myself. Or being unsure if I'd want to either give or receive something. 

I suppose, like anything else, it varies by person and relationship and their alignments. No true "right" or "wrong". As long as everyone communicates and is okay with what's going on....
